program='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)}
    if len(colors) != 1:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = next(iter(colors))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells]
    max_r = max(r for r, c in shape)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(rows - max_r):
        for left in range(cols - max_c):
            points = [(top + dr, left + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in points):
                for r, c in points:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
